e.S: Verified in source or registry (read by research agents, not re-checked)

dimensions.label: Licence
dimensions.help: Compatible with an Apache-2.0 project shipping a browser bundle, or flagged for legal review

dimensions.label: Browser-only
dimensions.help: Runs in the browser from static files, no per-user server

dimensions.label: React
dimensions.help: React 18/19 component, or an API a thin wrapper can drive with clean mount/unmount

dimensions.label: Maintained
dimensions.help: Recent release or commit, not archived, maintainer answers

dimensions.label: Tip events
dimensions.help: Click/hover on tips with a React callback

dimensions.label: Node events
dimensions.help: Click/hover on internal nodes and branches, with the descendant tips

dimensions.label: Tip links
dimensions.help: Tip label as a real, focusable link

dimensions.label: Clade colour
dimensions.help: Colour a clade from code and clear it again

dimensions.label: Custom columns
dimensions.help: Aligned per-tip content (counts, alignments, traits), ideally React-rendered

dimensions.label: Styling hooks
dimensions.help: Tokens, per-node style callbacks, dark mode

dimensions.label: Overview
dimensions.help: Whole-tree view, minimap, summaries when zoomed out

dimensions.label: Scale
dimensions.help: How many tips it handles, measured not claimed

dimensions.label: Tree ops

candidates.title: tbrowse
candidates.summary: React component for a tree with aligned data zones. Closest to the table-like layout we like.
candidates.verdict: Best model for the aligned-zones layout and URL-serialisable state. Hands-on (user): slow on large trees, no whole-tree zoom-out.

g3.t: Native React 18 component with controlled viewState

g4.t: npm 2.10.0 on 2026-09-02, commit 2026-10-02; 2.0 was a rewrite after a 2020 to 2026 gap; contributors not counted

tip.t: onSelectNode / onHoverNode in zone render props

node.t: selectedNodeId and hoveredSubtreeIds exist; internal node click not confirmed

clade.t: Not looked at in source; tested in the spike

cols.t: ZoneDefinition render props with virtualised rows; canvas MSA zone

layout.t: Phylogram/cladogram style only, no circular layout

bl.t: Nodes carry a distance; drawing not checked

overview.t: User tried the playground: no whole-tree zoom-out

scale.t: User found it slow on large trees (tip count not recorded). SVG tree.

parse.t: Flat node table input; no Newick or Nexus parser documented

ops.t: prune and swap in viewState; no reroot noted

candidates.title: react-bio-viz
candidates.summary: React components for biological views, including PhyloTree and a canvas alignment viewer.
candidates.verdict: Cleanest React API: controlled viewport and selection, node click returns the descendant tips. SVG without culling; one maintainer; very new releases.

g3.t: React 18/19; controlled and uncontrolled state props

g4.t: 0.1.0 to 0.3.0 released 2026-10-07/08 after a 2024 gap; one maintainer

tip.t: onNodeClick for tips; no hover callback

node.t: onNodeClick/onBranchClick fire for internal nodes with leafNames and descendantIds

clade.t: nodeStyles and branchStyles keyed by node id; build the clade map from descendantIds

link.t: leafTextComponent render prop can render an anchor (to verify in the spike)

cols.t: Alignment viewer shares row order; no column abstraction for the tree

style.t: Per-node and per-branch styles; bundled stylesheet; no dark mode noted

overview.t: No culling or level of detail; manual collapse only

scale.t: SVG, about 8 elements per tip, unmeasured; expect low thousands

parse.t: Newick only; recursive parser (deep trees risk overflow)

candidates.title: phylotree.js
candidates.summary: d3-based phylogenetics library with rendering, selection and tree operations.
candidates.verdict: Most hookable (click, hover, node and edge stylers) but SVG and old-style dependencies; needs our own React wrapper; smooth only to a few thousand tips (estimate).

g1.t: MIT per LICENSE file; no license field in package.json

g3.t: No component, no destroy(); wrapper with useRef/useEffect needed

g4.t: Maintained; contributor count inferred from emails only

node.t: nodeClick, branchClick, selectionChange pass the node object

clade.t: node-styler and edge-styler run for every node and edge; clade selection built in

link.t: Append an anchor in node-styler; own hit area

cols.t: Append SVG in node-styler, align-tips; no column abstraction

style.t: Style callbacks; no CSS variables or dark mode

overview.t: No culling; every update redraws everything

scale.t: Estimated smooth to 2-3k tips, laggy at 5-10k (agent estimate, unmeasured)

parse.t: Newick, first phyloXML tree; Nexus first tree only, no TRANSLATE

candidates.title: Phylocanvas.gl
candidates.summary: WebGL tree renderer from the Centre for Genomic Pathogen Surveillance; powers Microreact.
candidates.verdict: Scales best of the libraries we can embed, but no callbacks (method patching), tips-only selection, one canvas per page, deck.gl 8 pinned.

g3.t: No React component; own wrapper of about 100 lines

g4.t: Published 2026-07-13; upstream README says feature complete, no support

node.t: Selection is tips only; internal ids synthetic and unstable

clade.t: Per-tip styles only; collapse and re-root supported

cols.t: Coloured-block columns and custom deck.gl layers

style.t: Per-tip shape, colour, label; no CSS (WebGL)

parse.t: Newick only, naive tokenizer; no quoted delimiters

candidates.title: Archaeopteryx.js
candidates.summary: Full phylogenetic tree viewer (port of the Java tool) with heat map, alignment and domain tracks.
candidates.verdict: Richest built-in tracks and formats, but a whole app: no node click callback, singleton, one maintainer, large API churn.

g1.t: LGPL-3.0 plus LGPL-2.1+ phyloxml dependency; separate replaceable file needed

g3.t: Imperative launch/destroy; one viewer per page

g4.t: One maintainer; 22 releases in 33 days after a quiet period; 118 config keys removed in 3.0

node.t: Only a payload-less selected_nodes_changed_event on document

clade.t: Colour by property; highlight through view state search

cols.t: Built-in heat map, alignment, logo, domain tracks; not custom React content

style.t: Many config keys, some not honoured

bl.t: Phylogram, aligned and cladogram display modes

overview.t: Label thinning and windowed tracks; auto-collapse removed

parse.t: Newick, NHX, Nexus, phyloXML, Auspice JSON, BEAST annotations

ops.t: MAD and midpoint rooting, collapse, ladderize

candidates.title: Custom baseline (ours)
candidates.summary: A small typed-array tree model with a Canvas2D renderer and a React layer, designed to meet every criterion.
candidates.verdict: Design target, not yet measured. Agent estimate: about 9 engineer-weeks for an MVP at 100k tips. The spike builds a minimal version to set the performance ceiling.

tip.t: Design target, not built or measured

node.t: Design target, not built or measured

link.t: Design target, not built or measured

cols.t: Design target, not built or measured

style.t: Design target, not built or measured

layout.t: Design target, not built or measured

bl.t: Design target, not built or measured

overview.t: Design target, not built or measured

scale.t: Design target, not built or measured

parse.t: Design target, not built or measured

ops.t: Design target, not built or measured

candidates.title: Taxonium
candidates.summary: WebGL viewer for trees with millions of nodes, shipped as a whole app inside a React component.
candidates.verdict: Strong renderer, wrong packaging: GPL-3.0, React 19 only, singleton, only onNodeSelect. Not spiked.

g1.t: GPL-3.0; no license field in the component package

g4.t: Last commit 2026-10-07; npm 2026-02-04; about 85% of commits by one person

clade.t: Colour by metadata field or search state

bl.t: x axis can switch between distance and time

scale.t: Millions of nodes claimed; browser unreliable above about 6M tips

parse.t: Newick, Nexus via regex; no phyloXML

candidates.title: Reactree
candidates.summary: React component for Newick trees with an optional alignment panel.
candidates.verdict: Three props, no callbacks or custom content; rebuilds the whole SVG on any change; captures Ctrl/Cmd+F. Rejected.

g3.t: Component, but no callbacks or refs

node.t: Click collapses a clade internally; no event

style.t: CSS tokens and data-theme dark mode

scale.t: 26 px per leaf, whole SVG rebuilt on change

ops.t: Reroot and collapse in the UI

candidates.title: Heat-tree
candidates.license: MIT (R package); none in JS repo
candidates.summary: 2026 embeddable tree widget with JS, R and Python packages.
candidates.verdict: No click, hover or select callbacks and no highlight API; good Nexus parsing (TRANSLATE, multi-tree). Rejected as a component.

g1.t: MIT on the R package; no LICENSE file in the JS repo

parse.t: Nexus with TRANSLATE and multiple trees

candidates.title: OneZoom
candidates.summary: Tree of life explorer with about 2.2 million species; the strongest scale evidence in this list.
candidates.verdict: Architecture to learn from (compact topology, lazy nodes, adaptive level of detail), not a component: no npm package, global singleton, own data format, restrictive licence.

scale.t: 2.2M species live; 2.2M nodes in a 4.5 MB data file
